multiply.deviation: night base hue nudged toward teal (blue-green) per art review; luminance unchanged

lamps.shape: add: no air glow, tabletop 90, rev3: tabletop 116 core/100, soft floor ellipse 70/48/28-12 dithered rim + floor-only warm multiply 0.55/0.40/0.25-0.12 inside the same ellipse; multiply lift 0.55 on table cluster above floor only
add 40 on backsplash/counter top, 16 step above

window.note: moonlight shaft slanting down-right onto counter/floor

upper_wall.note: covered by the base map: night = cool base only (no pendant add, no table lift; y<110), evening = warm base + side bands

multiply.cast: draw cast with the same map at strength 0.25 when <1 (light cool tint), 0.6 when >1 (warm fill/rim)

add.order: out = clamp(src * multiply + add); multiply first, then add
add.cast: add at 0.6 strength on cast pixels

masking.note: Canonical night_multiplier_half.png and night_add_half.png have the wall mask baked in: they are exactly what scene() applies. No engine-side mask needed. Rule used: bare-wall pixels (the plain wall colours, y<129) get the cool base without the table lift, and get no pendant add in the table column x88-148. The *_unmasked.png files are raw lightmap() output for reference only. Do not ship them.
masking.apply: room: out = clamp(src*2*mult + 2*add) on opaque pixels. cast: multiply with strength 0.25 where mult<1 and 0.6 where mult>1 (f = 1+(m-1)*s), add x0.6. Emitters (pendant_on) are drawn ungraded on top of the room, before the cast.
